text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government publishes bill on system to replace Value Added Tax. The system is based on customs duty and a tax on products and services.

- Work to start in July on new Gozo ferries. The ferries, worth about $80 million in total, will be built in Malta to a Norwegian design. They will operate between Malta and the sister island of Gozo, three miles to the north.
- Police reforms affecting management of the force to be announced tomorrow. George Grech expected to remain commissioner.
- New taxation law published. No negative effect expected on cost of living, government says.
- Government deceiving the people on new taxation law. Opposition leader says government not really removing VAT, despite electoral promise.
